_comment: Egress policy for assistant coding workspaces. Both policies are open: any public host on TCP 80 and 443, except the domains listed under `blocked` (a domain also blocks its subdomains). The lists start empty; add a domain here to block it for that policy. `filter: family` adds the family DNS resolvers and the maintained public blocklists baked into the proxy image (infrastructure/ai-stack/egress/blocklists.json), and refuses address literals. Private, LAN and cluster addresses are refused for every policy and cannot be allowed here. A change is a reviewed repository change. See docs/ASSISTANT.md.
